$comment: Live-wire discriminator — the routing table for the THIRD contract leg (contract/live_conformance.py). fixtures-map.json routes a FILE to a schema; this file routes a LIVE message's (type + command) to a schema. Events are NOT listed here: the harness derives the event->schema routing automatically from each schema's own `type`/`name` consts (contract/README.md: 'A real build would generate that dispatch table from the set of message schemas'), so a new event schema is picked up with zero edits here. What the harness CANNOT derive is which schema a `rsp` satisfies, because an rsp carries no `name` on the wire (only an echoed correlation `id`) — the discriminator is the ORIGINATING COMMAND, known only to the caller. That command->schema mapping lives here. `validate` says whether the schema describes the whole rsp ENVELOPE (type/id/ok/data) or just the rsp `data` PAYLOAD (get_health's health snapshot is a bare payload). Every rsp is ALSO validated against the generic rsp.schema.json envelope regardless of this map.
